results.title: GLOBAL MARKETS-Traders brace for US jobs data after Fed's Waller soothes bond markets
results.description: World shares tip-toed higher ahead of US jobs data on Friday while bond markets got some much-needed relief after a top Federal Reserve official cooled rate-hike expectations and dragged the dollar lower The dollars retreat had run its course as the usual pre-payrolls holding patterns played out but it left the yen set for a weekly rise of nearly 25 its best since late July when Japan and the US conducted a rare joint intervention to halt a relentless slide in the Japanese currency
